title: Erdős #1027 OQ-01: Union Bound Lower Bound on Good Sets
description: For any n-uniform set family F over X = ∪F, the number of good subsets (intersecting every member but containing none) satisfies |goodSets F| ≥ 2^|X| − |F|·2^{|X|−n+1}. This union-bound lower bound gives an explicit quantitative version of the classical Erdős-Hajnal Property B result: if |F| < 2^{n-1}, then at least 2^|X|·(1 − |F|/2^{n-1}) good subsets exist.

overview.historicalContext: The Property B problem (2-colorability of hypergraphs) was introduced by Erdős and Hajnal in their 1961 paper 'On a property of families of sets', motivated by combinatorial topology and graph coloring. The classical threshold result — if F is n-uniform with |F| < 2^{n-1}, then F has Property B — follows from a probabilistic argument: a uniformly random 2-coloring fails to be good for a fixed A ∈ F with probability 2 · (1/2)^n = 2^{1-n}, so the expected number of 'bad' sets is |F| · 2^{1-n} < 1, guaranteeing a good coloring exists. The 2024 resolution of Erdős #1027 by Koishi Chan gave the quantitative strengthening that ≫_c 2^|X| good sets exist for |F| ≤ c·2^n. OQ-01 establishes an elementary lower bound — |goodSets F| ≥ 2^|X| − |F|·2^{|X|−n+1} — via a direct counting argument, providing a fully machine-verified version of the classical probabilistic bound.
overview.problemStatement:
**Open Question from Erdős #1027**:

The main result (Koishi Chan) gives ≫_c 2^|X| good sets for |F| ≤ c·2^n. **OQ-01** asks: what is the explicit lower bound? The union bound gives:

  `|goodSets F| ≥ 2^|X| - |F| · 2^{|X|-n+1}`

This is tight for the classical regime |F| < 2^{n-1}.
overview.text: A 183-line fully verified formalization of the quantitative union bound lower bound for Property B. For each A ∈ F (n-uniform), the bad subsets due to A — those missing A entirely (Disjoint B A) or containing A entirely (A ⊆ B) — number at most 2·2^{|X|−n}, since both {B ⊆ X : Disjoint B A} and {B ⊆ X : A ⊆ B} biject with the powerset of X \ A. Summing over all |F| members gives total bad ≤ |F|·2^{|X|−n+1}. Since goodSets and badTotal partition X.powerset (proved via `Finset.card_union_of_disjoint`), the good count is 2^|X| minus the bad count. The corollary recovers the classical Erdős-Hajnal threshold: if |F|·2 < 2^n, then the lower bound is positive, giving a good subset via `Finset.card_pos`.
keyInsights: The missing-subsets count uses Finset.subset_sdiff: B ⊆ X \ A ↔ B ⊆ X ∧ Disjoint B A, so the filter equals (X \ A).powerset
The containing-subsets count uses the involution B ↦ X \ B: this exchanges 'A ⊆ B' with 'Disjoint (X\B) A'
The Finset.card_union_le lemma directly gives the union bound for a single set A
The corollary exactly recovers the classical Erdős-Hajnal bound: |F| < 2^{n-1} implies |F|·2 < 2^n implies the lower bound is positive

A non-obvious symmetry: the count of subsets missing A (disjoint from A) equals the count of subsets containing A, both being 2^{|X|-|A|}. This follows because the complement involution B ↦ X \ B exchanges the two families, and its fixed-point-free nature (A ≠ ∅ is needed) ensures the bijection is strict.

sections.title: File Header and Setup
sections.summary: File header documenting the union bound strategy and proof that all 3 sorries are resolved. Imports Mathlib and Erdos1027Problem; opens Finset and Erdos1027 namespaces; sets up DecidableEq and Fintype variables.
sections.mathContext: The module establishes: $|\text{goodSets}(F)| \geq 2^{|X|} - |F| \cdot 2^{|X|-n+1}$. The three resolved sorries were: (1) card_subsets_containing via involution, (2) hbad_bound via biUnion bound, (3) hgood_bad via partition.

sections.title: Counting Subsets Missing A
sections.summary: card_subsets_missing: |{B ⊆ X : Disjoint B A}| = 2^{|X|-|A|}. Proved via Finset.subset_sdiff: the filter equals (X \ A).powerset.
sections.mathContext: The bijection: $B \subseteq X$ and $\text{Disjoint}\ B\ A \iff B \subseteq X \setminus A$. So the filtered powerset equals $(X \setminus A)\text{.powerset}$ with cardinality $2^{|X|-|A|}$.

sections.title: Counting Subsets Containing A
sections.summary: card_subsets_containing: |{A ⊆ B ⊆ X}| = 2^{|X|-|A|}. Proved via Finset.card_bij with the involution B ↦ X \ B. Fully proved: well-definedness, injectivity, and surjectivity all established.
sections.mathContext: The involution $B \mapsto X \setminus B$ on $\mathcal{P}(X)$ sends $\{A \subseteq B \subseteq X\}$ bijectively to $\{C \subseteq X : \text{Disjoint}\ C\ A\}$ since $A \subseteq B \iff A \cap (X \setminus B) = \emptyset$ for $B \subseteq X$.

sections.title: Single-Set Union Bound
sections.summary: card_bad_bound: |bad-due-to-A| ≤ 2 · 2^{|X|-|A|}. Proved via card_union_le plus the two counting lemmas.
sections.mathContext: $|\{B \subseteq X : B \cap A = \emptyset\} \cup \{B \subseteq X : A \subseteq B\}| \leq 2 \cdot 2^{|X|-|A|}$ by the subadditivity of cardinality.

sections.title: Main Union Bound Theorem
sections.summary: good_set_lower_bound: 2^|X| ≤ |goodSets F| + |F| · 2^{|X|-n+1}. Proved via biUnion covering (hbad_bound), partition of X.powerset (hgood_bad), and linarith with pow_succ.
sections.mathContext: By summing $\text{card\_bad\_bound}$ over all $A \in F$ via $\text{Finset.card\_biUnion\_le}$, and using $|\text{goodSets}| + |\text{badTotal}| = 2^{|X|}$ from the partition of $X\text{.powerset}$.

sections.title: Classical Erdős-Hajnal Corollary
sections.summary: property_b_from_union_bound: |F|·2 < 2^n → HasPropertyB F. Derives |goodSets F| > 0 from good_set_lower_bound via nlinarith, then extracts the witness via Finset.card_pos.
sections.mathContext: If $|F| \cdot 2 < 2^n$, multiplying by $2^{|X|-n}$ gives $|F| \cdot 2^{|X|-n+1} < 2^{|X|}$, so $|\text{goodSets}(F)| > 0$. The `pow_add` lemma relates $2^{|X|}$ and $2^n \cdot 2^{|X|-n}$ for the nlinarith call.

crossReferences.description: Extends the main Erdős #1027 file with a quantitative lower bound, vs. just existence (axiom) in the main file.
OQ-03 proves constructive existence via Lovász Local Lemma. OQ-01 gives a direct counting lower bound via the elementary union bound.

conclusion.summary: OQ-01 fully formalizes the quantitative union bound lower bound on good sets. card_subsets_missing is proved via Finset.subset_sdiff. card_subsets_containing is proved via Finset.card_bij with involution B ↦ X \ B. The main theorem combines these with a biUnion covering argument and partition of X.powerset.
conclusion.implications: Provides a complete, machine-verified, elementary lower bound on Property B good sets, recovering the classical Erdős-Hajnal threshold as a corollary.
openQuestions: Can the bound |F| · 2^{|X|-n+1} be improved to |F| · 2^{|X|-n} · (1 + ε) using inclusion-exclusion?
What is the optimal constant c* for Property B threshold? Can the Lovász Local Lemma bound be formalized directly?
Can this approach be extended to give the supersaturation bound ≫_c 2^|X| good sets for |F| ≤ c·2^n (Koishi Chan's result), by replacing the union bound with a second-moment method?
